notes.title: Play The Game!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]Thank you for playing [b]MPPP[/b] during the Steam Next Fest!
We’re excited to announce that the [b]full version of the game is now officially released![/b] 🎉[/p][p]We’ve made some score balancing adjustments across levels to ensure a fairer experience. More importantly, the full version includes [b]a variety of achievements[/b] waiting to be unlocked.[/p][p]Please note that the [b]leaderboard has been reset[/b] and is now separate from the demo version — so give it your best shot and aim for an even higher score![/p][p]We’re always open to feedback and suggestions, so feel free to share your thoughts on the [b]Community Hub[/b].[/p][p]That’s all for now.
[b]Happy playing![/b]
– Dev[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest demo is up!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello there![/b][/p][p]It’s Steam Next Fest season, and we’re excited to join with our new tiny little mini-game: [b]MPPP[/b]![/p][p][b]MPPP[/b] is a twisty arcade game born from one of our past game jam experiments—and we thought, [i]why not share it with the world?[/i] The [b]free demo[/b] is available throughout Steam Next Fest, and the full game will launch [b]one week after the event[/b] at a very humble price.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Try the demo and let us know what you think![/b]
Your feedback means a lot and will help us polish things before the full release.[/p][p]Happy playing!
— The Dev Team[/p]
